title: Fail CI when a diff weakens tests
body:
Outcome: a deterministic CI check fails a PR that deletes assertions, adds skip/only/todo, or deletes a test file without deleting its target, unless the PR body names the reason.
Why: weakened tests are the common agent defect (.krn/runs/strategy-review/report.md section 3); quality has no gate after 2026-11-07, so it needs a cheap mechanical floor.
Proof: rule test with fixture diffs for each case; runs in the Check.
Scope: this repository.
